name: Matthew Reindl
positioning: Emerging landscape architect · MLA, University of Cincinnati DAAP, 2026
tagline: Ecological public landscapes where flood resilience, recreation, planting systems, and clear visual storytelling work together.
bio: Matthew Reindl is a Cincinnati-based emerging landscape architect and 2026 Master of Landscape Architecture graduate of the University of Cincinnati DAAP. His work centers on public and civic landscapes where public health, ecology, water, recreation, and community use operate as connected systems. Alongside graduate work, he has supported the Cincinnati Recreation Commission with GIS park inventory, site assessment, planting design and procurement, and implementation support. Understory Designs is named for the vegetation layer beneath the canopy: the quiet stratum that does most of the ecological work.
